title: Extraction and analysis of zwitterionic metabolites from microalgae and bacteria
protocol: Make sure you have ready the equipment and solutions before the start of the procedure.
Label the vials before the start of the experiment.
Take a specific volume from your experimental culture using a serological pipette and transfer it into an Erlenmeyer flask.
Determine cell counts and/or chlorophyll a content of the culture and document the precise volume.
Filter the culture under reduced pressure (400 mbar) over a GF/C grade microfiber filter using the filtration unit.
Close the two-way stopcock as soon as the filter is dry.
Remove the glass part of the filtration unit and fold the filter on the glass frit two times using tweezers.
Transfer the filter to a 4 mL screw top glass vial containing 1 mL of methanol using tweezers.
Seal the vial with a Teflon lined screw cap.
Vortex the vial for 30 seconds.
Transfer 50 µL of the extract into a micro glass insert and dilute with 100 µL of a mixture of acetonitrile and water (9:1 v/v).
Centrifuge the micro glass insert for 5 min at 4500 rcf.
Transfer the supernatant to another micro glass insert.
Put the insert with the probe into a 1.5 mL screw top glass vial equipped with a spring to adjust the insert, close the lid and put it into the autosampler of the LC/MS system.
Inject 5 µL to the LC/MS.
Take 100 µL of the bacterial culture and transfer it to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge it for 5 min at 16,100 rcf.
Remove and discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Pipette 100 µL of a mixture of acetonitrile and water (9:1 v/v) on the cell pellet and vortex for 30 s.
Put the tube on ice and disrupt the cells by sonication using six 10 s pulses (40% intensity) in the ultrasound homogenizer.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 min at 16,100 rcf.
Transfer the supernatant into a micro glass insert of a 1.5 mL screw top glass vial equipped with a spring to hold the insert and close the lid.
Re-centrifuge if required to ensure the supernatant is free of any precipitate.
Inject 5 μL into the LC/MS system.
Prepare a concentrated stock solution of 10 μmol/L DMSOP in acetonitrile and water (9:1 v/v).
Perform dilutions to obtain solutions of 1000 nmol/L, 500 nmol/L, 300 nmol/L, 50 nmol/L, 10 nmol/L, 5 nmol/L, 1 nmol/L, and 0.5 nmol/L DMSOP.
Inject 5 μL of each concentration for LC/MS measurements.
Prepare a concentrated stock solution of the internal standard [2H]6-DMSA at a concentration of 16 µmol/L in acetonitrile and water (9:1 v/v).
Add 10 µL of the internal standard solution to your prepared sample.
Inject 5 µL of the mixture directly into the LC/MS system.
Measure DMSOP and [2H]6-DMSA containing solutions to determine the response factor ADMSOP/A[2H]6--DMSA for quantification of DMSOP.
Ensure work is conducted within the linear range of the detector.
Replace worn out injection needles as needed.
Replace worn out columns as needed.
Replace worn out seals as needed.
